mentions.name: Voila
mentions.description: This tool provides video proof of work for coding agents: agents upload a short recording of what they built, humans leave timestamped feedback on the video, and the agent can retrieve that feedback and iterate. The resulting videos can be shared in PRs, on Slack, or with teammates, replacing a bare 'done' message with visual proof.
mentions.problem: Instead of a coding agent just telling you 'done', there was no good way to show the work visually, collect human feedback on it, and share the results with a team.
mentions.audience: Coding agents and the developer teams collaborating with them
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building https://voila.show

Video proof of work for coding agents.

Agents upload a short recording of what they built, humans leave timestamped feedback, and the agent can retrieve that feedback and iterate.

Basically, instead of an agent telling you "done", it can show and you have a nice way to share the resulting videos in PR, on Slack, with your teammates etc.
